usedFor: Each new ActivityInfo record gets a Calendly booking link for the follow-up call.

bestTemplate.name: “New Record” in ActivityInfo, then “Create Scheduling Link” in Calendly
bestTemplate.why: A new record is when a follow-up is due; “Updated Record” would link every edit.

watchOut: Both triggers poll, so a new record's booking link can lag; pick one form to watch.
